ammonia.reason: Limited urea deamination and P. roqueforti deacidification in young moist blue at pH 5.9.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism; clean pasteurized cow milk make.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin plus P. roqueforti proteinases, masked by 2.4% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: Moderate 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from P. roqueforti beta-oxidation of fatty acids; lower than Stilton/Roquefort.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual lactose/galactose and proteolysis-derived amino acids on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism in pasteurized curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic 1258 mg/kg plus hexanoic 341 mg/kg from P. roqueforti lipase hydrolysis of milk fat.

creaminess.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~54.8% plus P. roqueforti proteolysis softens to buttery mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High moisture-in-nonfat ~65% and young age prevents dry granular fracture of harder blues.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 45.7% moisture uncooked rennet curd pierced for mold gives yielding paste.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism in short ripening.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butyrate/hexanoate from esterase esterification of acids with ethanol in mild blue.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goaty branched C8-C10 acids like 4-methyloctanoic characteristic of goat milk.

malty_nutty.reason: Limited Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal and no cooked-curd Maillard pyrazine formation.

melt.reason: Rennet curd pH 5.9 with intact calcium-casein network flows moderately on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from P. roqueforti lipoxygenase oxidation of linoleic acid.

oil_off.reason: 29.7% fat with partially lipolyzed fat globules releases moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol formation during indoor ripening.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low acetic acid 138 mg/kg plus lactic acid from starter; high pH 5.9 buffers sourness.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching/acid demineralization; rennet blue forms short non-fibrous melt.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism by Lactococcus plus P. roqueforti to dimethyl disulphide; uncooked curd limits H2S.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/lactate plus sweet ketones/lactones from high-fat cow milk.

umami.reason: Glutamate plus soluble peptides from rennet plus P. roqueforti proteolysis pH4.6-SN ~40%.
